verdict.rationale: Ghostty publishes an official library, libghostty, a zero-dependency C and Zig library for building terminal emulators or embedding terminal functionality. Its libghostty-vt component is described as usable today on macOS, Linux, Windows and WebAssembly, so there is a real first-party SDK to build against. However, it only covers C and Zig, has no evidenced API reference docs or versioning, and is aimed at terminal-emulator builders rather than general programmatic or agent integration. Missing for 10: SDKs in mainstream languages beyond C/Zig, in-depth API reference documentation, stability/release guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of building with libghostty.
